issues.description: The template code calls the stim.Circuit constructor with a parameter (stim.Circuit(n_shots)) while the rest of the materials (problem statement and solution) use stim.Circuit() with no arguments. Stim's Circuit constructor is not documented as taking a shot count parameter; the intended workflow is to create an empty Circuit and then use compile_sampler().sample(n_shots) to get samples. Leaving stim.Circuit(n_shots) in the template can confuse students and lead to a runtime error or misunderstanding about how to run multiple shots.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template to construct an empty stim.Circuit() (no arguments) inside simulate_msd_one_round, and instruct students to use circ.compile_sampler().sample(n_shots) to draw samples. Concretely, replace stim.Circuit(n_shots) with stim.Circuit() and ensure sampling is done via the sampler's sample method.
